units.source_text: 我常有相思难禁之时呢。”

en.t: There are often times when I cannot restrain my longing.

units.source_text: 梅壶女御对此岂能作答？

en.t: How could the lady of the Plum Pavilion possibly answer this?

units.source_text: 她只觉得莫名其妙。

en.t: She could only feel utterly bewildered.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣颇想乘此机会，发泄胸中关闭不住的怨恨。

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji was strongly tempted to seize this chance to vent the resentment he could no longer keep shut within his breast.

units.source_text: 或竟更进一步，做非礼之事。

en.t: He might even go a step further and do something improper.

units.source_text: 但念梅壶女御如此嫌恶他，亦属有理。

en.t: But he reflected that the lady of the Plum Pavilion had reason to detest him so much.

units.source_text: 而自己如此轻佻，也太不成样子。

en.t: And for him to behave so frivolously was far too unbecoming.

units.source_text: 于是回心转意，只是长叹数声。

en.t: So he changed his mind and merely gave several long sighs.

units.source_text: 此时他的姿态异常优美。

en.t: At that moment his bearing was exceptionally graceful.

units.source_text: 但女御只觉得讨厌。

en.t: But the lady only found him repellent.

units.source_text: 她渐渐向后退却，想躲进内室里去。

en.t: She gradually drew back, wanting to hide away in the inner room.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣对她说：“想不到你如此讨厌我！

en.t: The Inner Minister Genji said to her, I never imagined you disliked me so much!

units.source_text: 真正深解情趣的人，不应该如此呢。

en.t: Someone who truly understands feeling and refinement should not act like this.

units.source_text: 罢了罢了，今后请你勿再恨我。

en.t: Enough, enough; from now on, please do not resent me anymore.

units.source_text: 你若恨我，我很伤心啊！”

en.t: If you resent me, I will be deeply hurt!

units.source_text: 便告辞退出。

en.t: Then he took his leave and withdrew.

units.source_text: 他起身退出后，衣香留在室中，梅壶女御觉得连这香气也很讨厌。

en.t: After he rose and withdrew, the fragrance of his robes remained in the room, and the lady of the Plum Pavilion found even that scent hateful.

units.source_text: 侍女们一面关窗，一面相与言道：“这坐垫上留着的香气，香得好厉害啊！

en.t: As the waiting women closed the shutters, they said to one another, The scent left on this cushion is wonderfully strong!

units.source_text: 这个人怎么会长得这样漂亮？

en.t: How can that man have been born so beautiful?

units.source_text: 竟是‘樱花兼有梅花香，开在杨柳柔条上’呢。

en.t: He is truly like cherry blossoms with the fragrance of plum blossoms, blooming on the supple branches of a willow.

units.source_text: 真正教人爱杀呵！”

en.t: He truly makes one love him beyond endurance!
